summary: {person} rides with the crew after the department cannot document its rounds.
realLife: Seattle auditors accompanied cleaners in every maintenance district and observed forty cleanings when the department could not supply dependable visit counts.
gates: A published service goal and an incomplete visit log.
weights: A missing district makes an invitation from its crew more valuable.
inGame: needs: published target, assigned district, crew itinerary and an observer’s dated field notes.

turns.what: The observer sees which stops the shift actually covers.
turns.pulledBy: A crew offers a seat on its regular run.
turns.writesBack: Attach the field notes to the route review.

turns.what: The observer requests an ordinary shift as well.
turns.pulledBy: The visit falls on a special cleanup day.
turns.writesBack: Keep the special run labeled separately.
